prose:
A Google social post describes a Gemini 4 Hydrogen demonstration that codes a moving landscape in Google Sheets by changing thousands of cells frame by frame. The post says the work used Antigravity and labels the output as AI-made.

This is a promotional demonstration, not an evaluation of spreadsheet analysis, calculation reliability or general autonomous task performance. The fetched text describes the animation but does not independently verify the full production process or model availability.
highlights: Social post describes a cell-animation demo
Antigravity is named as the coding environment
Visual spectacle is not spreadsheet accuracy
Production process was not independently reproduced
